description:
FILED s515a (Opus, 2026-10-12) while probing the #3207 review.  PRE-EXISTING on main (same error at b91b8867), MEDIUM (a die where perl writes).
`my $t = "abc"; my $d = sub { ${$_[0]} =~ s/a/b/ }; $d->(\$t); print "$t\n";` -- perl `bbc`, PCL dies 'Modification of a read-only value attempted'.  Same with tr/a/b/, and with `my @a = (\$s); ${$a[0]} =~ tr/a/b/;`.  Through a plain scalar it works: `my $r = $_[0]; $$r =~ tr/a/b/` prints bbc.  So the deref-of-an-element target reaches do-regex-subst / do-tr as a non-box (a value), not the referent box.  Probes: scratch/s515a/pr/ro4.pl, ro5.pl in the s515a worktree.

=== DONE (s516a) ===
_write_through_form (the one 'a place the runtime can write through' rewrite) answers p-cast-$-box for a p-cast-$ form, and the =~ lowering asks it for a writing s/// or tr/// whose target is a scalar deref (4-argument substr gets it too).  ro4/ro5-shapes = perl, pos cleared / kept by #3207's rule.  Guard elem-pos-01.t rows 24-29 (24-27, 29 fail on main).  Commit 5c2897d8 (s516a).
subject: `${$_[0]} =~ s///` / `tr///` (an s/// or tr/// target that is a deref of an ELEMENT expression) dies 'Modification of a read-only value attempted'
